buffer.text:
MARKET CHECK 🇬🇧 — Skepta

Week two of the brand-new Official UK Rap Chart and the podium belongs to Skepta: Currency is new at No.1, Broken Hearts with Central Cee and Jorja Smith new at No.2, Secrets of Patriarchy new at No.3. Add Chiltern Firehouse with Fakemink at No.6 and he's on four of the top six, as The Fork and Knife, his first solo album since 2019's Ignorance Is Bliss, lands. Last week's No.1, What U Wanna Do by D-Block Europe & Young Adz, drops to No.7.

🎧 Track: Currency – Skepta

Who holds No.1 next Friday? Comment 1 for Currency, 2 for Broken Hearts.

buffer.text:
MARKET CHECK 🇮🇹 — Tony Boy vs Kid Yugi

FIMI week 46: Cura, Tony Boy's fifth studio album, debuts at No.1 and pushes Kid Yugi's album down to No.2. Kid Yugi answers on the singles chart: Sentire La Musica is No.1, and he collects three new golds in the same week. Geolier is on five of the top 20 singles, and Clementino & Rocco Hunt debut at No.3 albums with their first joint record, The Album.

🎧 Track: Sentire La Musica – Kid Yugi

Album No.1 next week? Comment 1 for Tony Boy, 2 for Kid Yugi.
